individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows micrographs (pseudocoloured confocal images), not a plot of averaged data, so this check does not apply.

Panel B consists of scatter/line plots of normalized intensity over time (raw measured data points fitted with a model curve) and insets showing averaged time-course responses as discrete data points rather than bar charts; scatter/line plots are exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points since the plotted points are themselves the individual measurements.

error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: not needed - Panel A contains micrographs with no error bars.

FAIL - The insets in panel B display data points with visible error bars (average early time point responses), but the caption does not state what these error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, or confidence interval).
